# 侦测到游牧帝国 / Nomadic Empire Sighted

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt（arkship.860 → arkship.865）、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1120 · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的舰队越过我国对其关闭的边界（或刚被驱逐后再入境）时，我国收到一次（每个游牧帝国一次，之后只有简讯），并降低对其好感（被驱逐后加倍）；外交行动“关闭边界”时若其舰队仍在境内也会检查。
When a nomad fleet crosses borders we closed to it (or re-enters after expulsion) we get this once per nomad (later only toasts) and an opinion penalty (doubled after expulsion); also checked when we close borders with their fleets inside.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 隐藏事件 arkship.860 检查条件后显示 arkship.865（单篇）。重复发生时只发送简讯，不再弹出事件。
  Hidden arkship.860 shows arkship.865 once; repeats only send a toast message.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支、无后续。No branches or follow-ups.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 见上。See above.
